_howto: Hackathons added by hand because none of the automatic sources list them. Required: id (short, lowercase, dashes), title, url (the organizer's own page). Optional: organizer, start, end (YYYY-MM-DD), mode (online, in-person, hybrid), city, region, country, prizeUsd (total CASH in US dollars, number only, leave out hardware and credits), prizeText, registrants (only if the organizer shows a live count), themes, eligibility (everyone, students, high-school). Leave out anything you can't confirm on the organizer's page. Ended events drop off on their own.
